detectors.description: The search returned no matching member records. This is a legitimate business answer ('no such member'), not an automation failure — callers receive it as an enumerated outcome.
The search form rejected the supplied Member ID as malformed (must be exactly five digits). Reported as a business outcome so the caller can correct its input rather than treating this as a crash.
